title: About implesta
description: implesta is built in Belgium by Bert Cattoor, for firms that sell their people's time and want every team to know what it needs to know.
h1: Built in Belgium, for firms that sell their people's time
lead: implesta exists because the information a team needs usually already exists somewhere else in the firm. It just doesn't arrive.
